subtitulo: On-site validation and full auditing of real factories in China.
descripcion: Our team in China searches for and validates factories based on your exact needs, so you never negotiate blind with a supplier you don't know.
queHacemos: Targeted search across specialized industrial clusters in China
Verification of business licenses and legal standing with the Chinese government
On-site audit of installed capacity and factory machinery
Direct negotiation of prices, MOQs, and payment terms
Thorough sample management and review before authorizing production orders

beneficios.descripcion: We filter out resellers and trading companies that inflate prices and offer no real guarantees.
We negotiate directly with plant owners and directors to maximize your margins.
We check tax history, ISO/CE certifications, and operational solvency.
Physical review of finish, measurements, and packaging before any money changes hands.

etapas.detalle: Exact definition of specifications, tolerances, and required standards.
A shortlist of 3 to 5 suitable plants verified against official records.
Shipping and physical validation of prototypes or production samples.
Bilingual manufacturing agreement with penalties for delays or defects.

specs.Plazo de reporte: 5 to 10 business days for a full shortlist
specs.Entregable: Dossier with photos, licenses, plant capacity, and a comparative cost matrix
specs.Sectores: Machinery, packaging, textiles, hardware, plastics, appliances, and technology

pendiente: Confirm with Kattya 2 or 3 real product categories where she has the most experience, to give a concrete example.
